newsitem.title: USA: Irata says combining with Photo-Me unit.
newsitem.headline: Irata says combining with Photo-Me unit.

text.p: Irata Inc said Monday it will combine its operations with Auto Photo Systems Inc, the U.S. subsidiary of Britain's Photo-Me International Plc, and immediately form a new limited liability company called Image Dynamics LLC.
Under the terms of agreement, Irata said it will own roughly 26 percent of Image Dynamics shares and and profits.

The designated chief executive officer of Image Dynamics, Lance Wimmer, the current chairman and chief executive of Irata said, "Combined, Irata and Auto Photo revenues for the coming year are expected to be about $25 million with cash flow generation in excess of $4.0 million."
Combined, the companies will have 2,100 photo booths in operation worldwide, Irata said.
